name: Disable Power Throttling
description: Disables Windows power throttling for background tasks so applications are less aggressively limited by the system.

description_i18n.en: Disables Windows power throttling for background tasks so applications are less aggressively limited by the system.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Leistungsreduzierung für Hintergrundaufgaben, sodass Anwendungen weniger stark vom Energiesystem begrenzt werden.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la limitation de puissance pour les tâches en arrière-plan afin que les applications soient moins limitées par le gestionnaire d'énergie.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value PowerThrottlingOff at HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerThrottling to enable or disable power throttling for background tasks
